Name: Flowering Falls Farm
Author: KristaIsGayAsf
TagLine: Custom farm map made with Content Patcher. Includes a pond, river, and waterfall. All grass is diggable/buildable. Compatible with 1.6.
Description:
❤❤ Flowering Falls Farm ❤❤
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Compatible with 1.6.
Not available for mobile yet.
Replaces "Standard" farm.
All grass is diggable and buildable.
Includes a pond, a river, and a waterfall, as well as pre-designed areas for crops and coops/barns.
Pet bowl has been moved from default spot, would recommend talking to Robin to move it where you'd like though.
Only works 100% properly when starting a new save. If you try running this mod with a previous save, you run the risk of corrupting your save file.


REQUIREMENTS
Requires SMAPI﻿ (minimum version 4.0.4)
Requires Content Patcher﻿ (minimum version 2.0.4)
Requires DaisyNiko's Tilesheets (minimum version 1.9.1)﻿


Installation
Step 1: Install the latest versions of SMAPI, Content Patcher and DaisyNiko's Tilesheets, then download this mod.
Step 2: Extract the "[CP] Flowering Falls Farm" folder into your Stardew Valley "Mods" folder.
Step 3: Run the game with SMAPI and start a new save file on the "Standard" farm.


Image Information
In the images section I've included vanilla screenshots, as well as modded screenshots.
The visual mods I'm using in these photos include:
Vibrant Pastoral Recolor﻿
Elle's Seasonal Buildings﻿
Wyrd's Seasonal Mailboxes
